nodes.label: Memory Backup Standing Rule
nodes.rationale: After completing any task on SponsorX, update memory and back it up under Memory/YYYY-MM-DD/ (create the dated subfolder first if missing); Initial Memory/ stays the baseline snapshot updated only when foundational facts change. This in-repo copy proved its worth when Claude's persistent memory store was lost in a machine change (2026-09-11 Task 8).
